title: SSC CHT/ JHT/ JT Tier-I Exam City Details 2026 Out for 303 Post
intro: Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has Officially Released Tier-I Exam City Details for the Post of Junior Hindi Translator (JHT)/ Junior Translation Officer(JTO)/ Junior Translator (JT) , Junior Translation Officer (JTO) & Senior Hindi Translator (SHT)/Senior Translator (ST)/ Senior Translation Officer (STO) Recruitment 2026 for 303 Post. Check All Details, Like Age Limit, Eligibility Details, Post Information, Pay Scale, Selection Process & More Details Related to SSC CHT Jobs. Tier-I Exam Held On September 8, 2026 & Tier-I Exam City Released OnAugust 31, 2026. All Interested Candidates Can Download Tier-I Exam City Details Now in the Given Link Below.
importantDates: Fee Payment Last Date : 15 May 2026 (11:00 PM)
Fee Payment Last Date : 15 May 2026 (11:00 PM)
Payment Mode: Pay the Exam Fee Through Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking Fee Mode.
Candidates Born not Before 02.08.1996 and not later than 01.08.2008 are Eligible to Apply
Age Relaxation Extra As Per SSC Recruitment Rules.

Paper-I (Computer Based Examination): The questions will be designed to test the candidates‟ understanding of the languages and literature, correct use of words, phrases and idioms and ability to write the languages correctly, precisely and effectively. The questions will be of degree level.
Paper-I will consist of Objective Type Multiple choice questions only.
There will be negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer in Paper-I. Candidates are, therefore, advised to keep this in mind while answering the Question.

Paper-II (Translation and Essay): This paper will contain two passages for translation -one passage for translation from Hindi to English and one passage for translation from English to Hindi, and an Essay each in Hindi and English, to test the candidates‟translation skills and their ability to write as well as comprehend the two languages correctly, precisely and effectively. The level of the paper will be consistent with the educational qualifications prescribed.
Pay Scale:  JTO/ JHT:- Rs.35,400-1,12,400 Level-6 ||  For SHT/ ST/ STO:- Rs.44,900-1,42,400/- Level-7
Mode of Selection:   Selection on the Basis of Online Exam (CBT) & Skill Test.
15 May 2026: Last date for fee payment.
Age Relaxation: As per SSC Rules.
Master’s Degree in Hindi/English with relevant combination OR any subject with Hindi/English medium + Translation Diploma/Experience.
Total Vacancy: 84 Posts (Junior & Senior Hindi Translator)
Selection Process: Computer Based Test (CBT) + Skill Test
Central Government Translation Jobs in Various Ministries
84 Vacancies – Good Chance for Hindi/English Experts
